title: AuditMetadata
description: SAIA-Class S audit metadata envelope providing traceability, integrity, and provenance for all Beast System 3.0 objects.

auditId.description: Unique identifier for this audit metadata record (UUID recommended).

traceId.description: Trace identifier linking this object to a chain of related operations.

parentTraceId.description: Optional parent trace identifier for hierarchical audit chains.

actorId.description: Identity ID of the actor responsible for the operation.

component.description: Subsystem that produced the audited object (governance-kernel, registry-service, wellbeing-engine, predictive-engine, doctrine-compiler, etc.).
